items.name: Sequence as developmental engine
items.description: Ascending or descending sequences of 3–4 repetitions move the music forward. The sequence is harmonically directed (circle-of-fifths, descending thirds, ascending seconds) and never just decorative.

items.name: Motivic saturation
items.description: A short 2–4 note cell from the opening generates everything: the melody, the bass line, the inner voices, the countersubject. If you can trace every important note back to the opening motif, it's Bach
